name: Write erotic stories in simple Turkish
description: Users asked the AI to write erotic or pornographic stories in simple or easy Turkish, typically specifying a word count of around 1000 to 2000 words and a particular title. These requests frequently included constraints to use only present tense verbs and detailed scenarios involving characters removing clothing, stripping, or engaging in sexual acts.
